pages.aboutFirst: Stat makes it simple to find a dependable car for every journey. Browse vehicles, choose your dates, and book with confidence.
pages.aboutSecond: We also help car owners earn from their vehicles by providing an easy way to list and manage their cars.
pages.helpText: Need help with a booking or listing a car? Contact our support team at info@gmail.com and we will help you as soon as possible.
pages.termsText: By using Stat, you agree to provide accurate booking and vehicle information. Bookings are subject to vehicle availability and the terms shown at checkout.
pages.privacyText: We use your account and booking details only to operate the rental service, manage reservations, and provide support. We do not sell your personal information.
pages.insuranceText: Insurance coverage and eligibility can vary by vehicle and booking. Review the details provided for your selected car before confirming your reservation.
